scientific_integrity: Theorems are proved analytically on Hardy H²; finite rational checks corroborate exact formulae, not infinite conclusions. Parent Hausdorff operator is defined on polynomials and may be unbounded; the shift commutator is initially a formal polynomial-domain expression.
scientific_limitations: No trace-class or full singular-value asymptotic claim
No claim about summability of nonsquare-summable coefficient series under nonstandard summation
An earlier general commutator Gram formula might subsume part of the result
title: Hilbert–Schmidt regularization of lacunary Hausdorff matrices by the unilateral shift
